pages.title: Learn
pages.headline: Make sense of digital trust.
pages.excerpt: Explore wallets, credentials and the roles behind them. Follow a knowledge route at your own pace, or bring your team to a guided session.

pages.title: Topics
pages.headline: Choose what you want to understand.
pages.excerpt: Start with the big picture or go straight to a question. There is no required sequence and no account is needed.

pages.title: The big picture
pages.excerpt: Before choosing a wallet or a standard, understand what needs to be trusted — and who can provide the evidence.

pages.title: For businesses
pages.excerpt: Start with a business process: what must your organisation prove, receive or check?

pages.title: How credentials connect issuers, wallets and services
pages.excerpt: A simple example explains the roles: a training provider issues a qualification, its recipient keeps it in a wallet, and an employer checks it.
pages.sources:
FIDES · Verifiable Credentials | https://fides.community/topics/verifiable-credentials/

pages.cta_text: Browse use cases, then follow the connections to issuers, wallets and services.
